### Usage in Tests

The test fixtures contain Chapter I: "Childhood" from the book, chosen for its:
- Self-contained narrative
- Rich descriptive content
- Mix of personal reflection and historical detail
- Appropriate length for testing document processing functionality

This content is used solely for testing purposes and to demonstrate the RAG system's ability to process and analyze historical biographical content. The system will ultimately help generate meaningful family history interview questions by analyzing context documents shared by users, helping families capture their own stories and experiences.
